main_text.l: כְּתַל כֹּתֶל m. Paries. Chald. כְּתַל: plurale, כְּתְלָא.
נִכְתַּם Niphal Inaurari; Auro obduci: alii, Maculari, ex significatione Chaldaica & Rabbinica.
כְּתֹנֶת, כֻּתְּנַת f. Tunica: plural. כְּתָנוֹת כֻּתָּנוֹת.
כָּתֵף, כָּתֵף f. Humerus, Latus, Scapula: plur. כְּתֵפוֹת, כְּתֵפַיִם.
כָּתַר Cingere: Exspectare, ex usu Chaldaeo. Hiphil Circumcingere, Coronare.
מַכְתֵּשׁ m. Mortarium: item Cavum, Cavitas.
כָּתַת Contundere, Conterere. Pihel כִּתֵּת & Hiphil הִכְתִּית idem. Hophal הוּכַּת Contundi.
כְּתִית m. Tusum. מִכְתָּה f. Contusio.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vocalisation is reconstructed from a faded scan; several points are uncertain and marked by the entry structure rather than verified letter by letter. The small Hebrew mark at lower right is treated as a catchword.
